articles.title: Today in History: December 3, toxic gas leak kills thousands in Bhopal
articles.description: Today is Thursday, Dec. 3, the 337th day of 2026. There are 28 days left in the year. Today in history: On Dec. 3, 1984, a cloud of methyl isocyanate gas escaped from a pesticide plant

articles.title: The Cast of ‘Friends’ And Their Most Recent Project
articles.description: Even more than two decades later, Friends continues to be an influential show in television and beyond, forming for many the bases of humor and sitcom storytelling. Many highly popular faces came from the show, but even the ones you haven’t heard about have had recent projects as well. The sad passing of Matthew Perry means that you won’t see the entire core cast, yet there’s enough here to satiate your curiosity. From the central New Yorkers to the memorable supporting players who helped make the sitcom such a phenomenon, here's what the surviving members of the Friends cast have been working on lately. The post The Cast of ‘Friends’ And Their Most Recent Project appeared first on Den of Geek.

articles.title: Santa Barbara Man Among Americans In Russian Captivity As Ukraine War Rages
articles.description: WASHINGTON D.C. (KEYT) – Last week, local Congressman Salud Carbajal met with the family of Aleksandr Antonov, a 66-year-old Santa Barbara man imprisoned in Russia since March of 2025. "My family and I are so grateful to Rep. Carbajal for his proactive leadership in advocating for my father's freedom," Anastasia Antonova, Mr. Antonov's daughter, shared. The post Santa Barbara Man Among Americans In Russian Captivity As Ukraine War Rages appeared first on News Channel 3-12.
